stance_rationale: The optimizer has a real 219-date weight schedule and passes basic name/weight/sum/turnover constraints, but required hard audits fail on liquidity/universe, covariance condition, artifact schema, and infeasible-MDD selection logic. This is not ready for Forge/Judge without revision because several failures are either omitted from hard_constraint_validation or rationalized as handoff issues.

method_shopping_audit.selection_method: No MDD-feasible candidate; selected highest SR_net Top_EW at boundary w_alpha=0.30, not the closest MDD candidate.

cost_audit.cost_proportionality_check: Package reports cost_pa=0.0071 using turnover*15bps one-way; role prompt round-trip check implies about 0.0140, so net metrics may be cost-understated by about 70bps annually.

hard_constraint_violations: t-1 20d trading value audit found 6 selected weight rows below 2e8 KRW; package hard_constraint_validation omits liquidity.
2 selected weight rows were outside KOSPI200/KOSDAQ150 or halted on the rebalance date under rawdata fields.
PG0 MDD target -25% is infeasible; selected portfolio still reports MDD_net=-28.87%.
covariance.parquet is PSD but audited condition number is 224.917, above the requested post-shrink <=100 threshold.

sequential_admission_audit.integration_weight_breakdown: Reported only 70% STR_1715 / 30% Top_EW; no TDC vs PG2/MEGA_05, no replacement scenario, and request current_portfolio was STR_1631_80_STR_1656_20.

critical_concerns.description: Liquidity/universe hard constraints are not clean: audited t-1 20d trading value has 6 selected rows below 2e8 KRW, and 2 selected rows are outside KOSPI200/KOSDAQ150 or halted on rebalance date. Package hard_constraint_validation only checks n/sum/long-only/cap, so the hard audit is incomplete.

covariance.parquet is PSD but condition number audits at 224.917, above the user-required post-shrink <=100 threshold; package also conflicts between risk delta_shrinkage=0.05 and optimizer rolling covariance delta=0.20. This undermines any MVO/ERC/MaxDiv comparison using Σ.

The package calls Top_EW+w_alpha=0.30 the closest infeasible approximation, but it selected the highest SR_net after zero MDD-feasible candidates; Top_InvVol has a closer MDD_net (-28.61% vs -28.87%). CVaR contribution requested by Risk for 5-15% allocation is not shown despite selecting 30%.

The required alpha_scores.parquet is a single snapshot with columns Ticker, alpha, alpha_z, confidence and no Date/sig_date, violating the base time-series artifact contract. weights.csv is time-series, but its schema is Date,Ticker,Weight and lacks required as_of_date/method_selected; the mailbox weights.csv path requested by the prompt is absent.

Method-shopping accounting is too narrow: package reports candidates_tried=8, but selection actually spans method plus 11 blend weights and picks the upper boundary w_alpha=0.30; the effective search space is not reconciled to the <=10 cap.

RF-O1 signal-loss audit fails silently: comparing composite_alpha_panel top-20 alpha names to weights found 81 top-20 alpha-date omissions across 64 dates, apparently due hidden return/covariance coverage filtering with no exclusion report.

Cost is likely understated versus the role prompt's round-trip check: actual schedule turnover annualizes to 4.679, implying about 1.40% annual cost under turnover*15bps*2, while package reports 0.71%. Regime-switch cost is not internalized.

Sequential Admission is incomplete: no TDC vs PG2/MEGA_05, no replacement-vs-integration split, and no blended beta_port target [1.00,1.05] audit. AX-008 triangulation cannot be called ready from this package alone.

supporting_arguments: Basic per-date weight math passes: 219 dates, 20 names per date, max weight 0.05, sum weight exactly 1.0, long-only, and audited annual one-way turnover 4.679 < 6.0.
The selected weights are not a single static snapshot; weights.csv has 4380 rows across 219 dates and aligns with composite_alpha_panel dates.
An MDD infeasibility report is present, and the package does not hide that no candidate met the -25% MDD target.
Exact base-context rationalization phrases were not detected by text search.
unresolved_disputes: Whether the candidate cap should count only optimizer methods or method × blend-weight grid points; the current package counts only methods.
Whether liquidity is allowed to use same-day month-end DV20; PIT-C10 implies t-1, and the inclusive check masks the 6 liquidity breaches.
Whether STR_1715 is the correct active book for integration when request.json names current_portfolio as STR_1631_80_STR_1656_20.
Whether the covariance <=100 threshold applies to full security covariance in covariance.parquet or only factor Ω; the user explicitly named covariance.parquet.
Whether an S5 overlay can remediate the -25% MDD target before Judge, or whether the optimizer package itself must remain rejected until overlay evidence exists.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that Top_EW + 30% alpha is an acceptable closest approximation after MDD infeasibility; audited metrics show it is an SR-boundary choice, not the closest MDD/CVaR-safe solution.
rebuttal_required: Re-issue hard_constraint_validation including t-1 liquidity, KOSPI200/KOSDAQ150 membership, trading halt, and artifact path/schema checks.
Provide a covariance remediation or justify why condition number >100 is acceptable for every optimizer method compared.
Re-run selection with an explicit infeasible-objective rule: minimize MDD gap/CVaR breach first, then net_IR, or label the chosen portfolio as SR cherry-pick.
Emit weights.csv with as_of_date,ticker,weight,method_selected and provide a time-series alpha_scores artifact or remove it from Forge handoff.
Report CVaR contribution and stress contribution for the selected 30% integration weight, not only standalone alpha GFC contribution.
Provide Sequential Admission TDC vs PG2/MEGA_05, replacement scenario, integration scenario, and blended beta_port audit.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The package has useful schedule construction, but the external audit finds hard-constraint omissions and selection-rule drift that Claude's package does not resolve.

optimizer_specific_questions: Can Forge consume this safely when weights.csv lacks method_selected and the listed alpha_scores.parquet is single-snapshot?
Why is Top_EW called closest approximation when Top_InvVol has a closer MDD to the -25% target?
Why did a 5-15% risk recommendation become 30% without CVaR contribution evidence?
Should the method-shopping cap include the 11 blend weights and boundary-selected w_alpha=0.30?
Which active book is authoritative for Sequential Admission: STR_1715 or request.json current_portfolio STR_1631_80_STR_1656_20?
